about.title: About Me
about.quote: Every interface should reflect the people who use it.
paragraphs: I'm Tannaz Samiyan, a freelance web designer and front-end developer with a background in computer engineering. I design and build websites that combine distinctive visual identities with smooth user experiences and reliable technical foundations.

To me, front-end development is a combination of logic and aesthetics. That's why I pay as much attention to clean, maintainable code and technical performance as I do to details like typography, layout, spacing and visual consistency.

I use Next.js, React, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS to develop modern, responsive and optimized websites. I also specialize in bilingual Persian and English websites, with proper right-to-left (RTL) support.

For architecture, interior design and brand-focused projects, I aim to create websites that reflect each client's unique identity and style. Working directly with me means having one point of contact throughout the entire process, from the initial conversation and concept development to implementation, launch and ongoing support.
